claims.content: To allow an authorized Operator to activate command control via the GUI logon screen.

goal.raw_text: To allow an authorized Operator to activate command control via the GUI logon screen.

claims.content: Operator
The Operator has logged in via the GUI logon screen with a valid user name and corresponding password.
The Operator has authorization to activate command control.
The Operator is using a specified workstation from which command control is permitted.
The Operator requests command control after logging in and being authorized.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator requests command control after logging in and being authorized.

claims.content: The Operator logs in via the GUI logon screen by providing a user name and corresponding password.
If the Operator requests command control and has authorization, the system activates command control for the user.
Command control is granted only if the Operator is using a specified workstation.
If command control is enabled by another user, and the logging in user is of higher security, the logging in user shall be requested to accept or deny command control.
If another user is logged in with command control and the new user takes command control, the other user is notified.

If command control is enabled by another user, and the logging in user is of higher security, but the logging in user denies the request to accept command control, the system shall not activate command control for the new user.
If the Operator does not have authorization to activate command control, the system shall not activate command control.
If the Operator attempts to activate command control from a workstation that is not specified/authorized, the system shall not activate command control.
Command control is activated for the Operator.
The Operator can view system status, issue commands to change device status, configure the system, export log data, and generate reports via the GUI.
If another user was previously logged in with command control and the new Operator took command control, that other user is notified.
